crossRefs.note: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord…
But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who…
As you enter into the household, greet it.
Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since…
For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved and in those who perish:
Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his…
Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his…
“When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
But into whatever city you enter, and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

translations.web: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse, for they are a rebellious house, yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.
translations.bsb: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
